webhook.body: {"text": "[Health Watchers] Failed-auth spike: {{ctx.payload.hits.total}} failed login attempts in the last 5 minutes (threshold: 20). Index: health-watchers-audit-*"}

_meta.notes: Watches the health-watchers-audit-* index (audit_action/audit_outcome fields are populated from parsed[auditAction]/parsed[auditOutcome] in logstash/pipeline/health-watchers.conf). Assumes the application emits auditAction="login" and auditOutcome="failure" for failed logins — adjust the term values if your app uses different strings. REPLACE the webhook URL above with a real Slack incoming-webhook or PagerDuty Events API URL before enabling in production.
